basic_details.job_title: BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One temporary Research Associate (RA) position is open under an ANRF project (the NFSG Project) at the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani – Hyderabad Campus, on the project "Accelerated Deterministic and Stochastic Variational Inequality Methods for Large-Scale Optimization and Data-Driven Applications". The appointment is for 6–9 months starting from 01 February 2027 at Rs. 25,000 per month. Candidates need a Ph.D. degree in Mathematics or Operations Research with experience in Python and MATLAB, and must email their application and detailed CV with all publications to the Prin

important_dates.interview_date: Date, time and mode to be informed to shortlisted candidates by email

how_to_apply: Applications are made by email only, as the notice describes. No application form or email subject line is specified in the notice.
Prepare your application and a current detailed CV with all your publications.
Email them to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Kanchan Mittal, at [email protected].
Submit the application on or before 15 December 2026.

rows.details: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani – Hyderabad Campus
Accelerated Deterministic and Stochastic Variational Inequality Methods for Large-Scale Optimization and Data-Driven Applications

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Ph.D. degree in Mathematics or Operations Research, with experience in Python and MATLAB. Desirable qualification / skills: Knowledge or research experience in optimization, game theory, stochastic optimization, algorithm development, and machine learning. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Fellowship / Remuneration is Rs. 25,000 per month. The appointment is temporary and project-based, for 6–9 months, subject to the sanctioned project duration and applicable rules. The tenure starts from 01 Feb 2027. The selected candidate will be governed by applicable institute rules and the terms stated in the appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: BITS Pilani Hyderabad RESEARCH ASSOCIATE (RA) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will carry out research related to accelerated deterministic and stochastic methods for variational inequalities, large-scale optimization, and data-driven applications. Duties may include: Developing, implementing, and testing algorithms Computational experiments using Python and MATLAB Reviewing relevant literature Contributing to research reports, manuscripts, and project meetings as assigned by the Principal Investigator

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BITS Pilani Hyderabad RESEARCH ASSOCIATE (RA)
content_sections.text: Applications are made by email only, as the notice describes. No application form or email subject line is specified in the notice. Prepare your application and a current detailed CV with all your publications. Email them to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Kanchan Mittal, at [email protected] . Submit the application on or before 15 December 2026. Application Current detailed CV with all the publications Original certificates and supporting documents – candidates may be required to produce them for verification at interview or joining

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting will be based on merit and project requirements. Possession of the essential qualification does not guarantee an interview call. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email regarding the interview date, time, and mode.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Research Associate (RA) position under the ANRF project at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted by email on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. degree in Mathematics or Operations Research, with experience in Python and MATLAB.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate?
faq.answer: The Fellowship / Remuneration is Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Email your application and current detailed CV with all publications to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on merit and project requirements, and shortlisted candidates are informed by email of the interview date, time, and mode. Having the essential qualification does not guarantee an interview call.

faq.question: Q7. Is the BITS Pilani Hyderabad Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is temporary and project-based, for 6–9 months, subject to the sanctioned project duration and applicable rules.

faq.question: Q8. When does the Research Associate appointment start?
faq.answer: The tenure of the project appointment starts from 01 Feb 2027.

faq.question: Q9. What desirable skills are listed for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Knowledge or research experience in optimization, game theory, stochastic optimization, algorithm development, and machine learning is desirable.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents should be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their application and current detailed CV with all the publications; original certificates and supporting documents may be required for verification at interview or joining.
